checks.note: The Dockerfile and ci.yml:20 depend on package-lock.json, but no lockfile exists in the repo tree. Only direct dependencies are pinned in package.json, so no transitive version or integrity hash is recorded. The check treats a missing lockfile as a failure. The base images are digest-pinned and the actions are SHA-pinned.

No local model loads exist. Grep found no pickle, torch.load or joblib use.
The served model comes from res.model, in its own field. It is recorded separately from the requested model in both the agent and the classifier. The classifier also routes to staff on a mismatch.
